_note: Hand-derived expected connectivity matrix for the overlapping-selectors fixture. Codes: A=ALLOW (both sides permit); I=DENY because the destination ingress side is isolated and no rule matched; E=DENY because the source egress side is isolated and no rule matched; B=DENY because BOTH sides are isolated with no match; U=UNDECIDABLE. Rows are sources and columns destinations, in engine sort order (namespace,name). Derived entirely by hand from the fixture; the engine never generates this file.

cells._explain: api is egress-isolated and its egress policy only permits destinations labelled app=web; api itself is not web
billing egress allows all same-namespace destinations ({} peer) and matches on http; api has no ingress policy so the ingress side defaults allow
the {} egress peer selects every pod in prod including billing itself; billing has no ingress policy
overlapping ingress selectors: devbox is neither app=api nor app=billing, so neither overlapping policy admits it
cross-namespace: api egress policy peer is a bare podSelector, which only matches within the policy's own namespace prod
db-wall selects db in both directions with zero rules
peer would match on both sides but the policies only allow named port http=8080; 9090 metrics is not listed
the egress peer matches web-b, but web-b serves only 8080: the named http cannot resolve to 9090 on that destination, and its ingress rules only list http
egress permits named http only; billing serves no 9090 and the name does not resolve there
neither side is selected: web-a has no egress policy, api has no ingress policy; the unmatched destination port 9090 is irrelevant when no policy applies

sweeps._explain: Only api and billing are egress-isolated; webs and devbox are not. All named rule ports are TCP, so UDP can never match a port rule; db is isolated both directions regardless of protocol.

cells._explain: web-a has no egress policy and devbox has no ingress policy: protocol mismatch only matters where a port rule exists
named http resolves to TCP only; UDP never matches the rule ports
